question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unused and in their original packaging.

question: How long do refunds take?
keywords: when will I get my money
answer: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive your returned item. The money goes back to your original payment method.

question: How do I track my order?
answer: Open the 'My Orders' page and click 'Track' next to your order. You will also get a tracking link by email and SMS once your order ships.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express delivery takes 1-2 business days and is available in most major cities.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Shipping is free on orders above Rs. 499. For smaller orders, standard shipping costs Rs. 49.

question: Do you offer cash on delivery?
answer: Yes, cash on delivery is available for orders up to Rs. 5,000 in most pin codes. A small handling fee of Rs. 25 applies.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, popular wallets, and cash on delivery.

question: How can I cancel my order?
answer: Go to 'My Orders', select the order, and click 'Cancel'. Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped. After shipping, you can return the item instead.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
answer: You can change the address before the order is shipped. Go to 'My Orders', pick the order and click 'Edit Address'. After shipping, the address cannot be changed.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click 'Sign Up' at the top right, enter your name, email and phone number, then verify the OTP we send you. It takes less than a minute.

question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your registered email, and we will send you a link to set a new password.

question: How do I apply a discount coupon?
answer: On the checkout page, type your coupon code in the 'Apply Coupon' box and click 'Apply'. The discount will show in your order summary.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Payments can fail due to insufficient balance, a wrong OTP, or a bank-side limit. Please try again or use a different payment method. If money was deducted, it is refunded automatically within 3-5 business days.

question: What if I receive a damaged or wrong product?
answer: We are sorry about that! Go to 'My Orders', select the order and click 'Report an Issue' with a photo within 48 hours. We will send a replacement or refund.

question: Do products come with a warranty?
answer: Electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. The warranty details are listed on each product page and in your invoice.

question: Can I exchange a product for a different size or color?
answer: Yes, exchanges are available within 15 days of delivery, subject to stock availability. Choose 'Exchange' instead of 'Return' in 'My Orders'.

question: Do you deliver internationally?
answer: Not yet. Right now we deliver only within India, but international shipping is planned for the future.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: You can email support@shopease.example or call 1800-000-0000 between 9 AM and 9 PM, Monday to Saturday. Live chat is available right here too.

question: What are your customer support working hours?
answer: Our support team is available from 9 AM to 9 PM, Monday to Saturday. This chatbot is available 24/7.

question: Is my personal and payment information safe?
answer: Yes. All payments are encrypted and processed through secure payment gateways. We never store your full card details and never share your data with third parties.

question: Do you have a mobile app?
answer: Yes, the ShopEase app is available for Android and iOS. Download it from the Play Store or App Store for exclusive app-only deals.

question: How do I subscribe to the newsletter for offers?
answer: Enter your email in the 'Subscribe' box at the bottom of the home page. You can unsubscribe at any time from any email we send.

question: Where can I find my invoice?
answer: Open 'My Orders', select the order and click 'Download Invoice'. A copy is also sent to your registered email after delivery.
